title: Keyframe opacity or transform values in Luxea Pro 8
note: Select a media asset on the Luxea 8 timeline. In the Properties panel, use the diamond icon for a parameter at the playhead, then move forward and set another value. The Properties keyframe timeline can show interpolation graphs; Linear and Bezier options change the motion curve.

title: Copy matching keyframes between clips in Luxea
note: Luxea 8 permits copying selected keyframes from a clip's Properties timeline and pasting them onto another clip when the keyframes correspond to the same property. Reuse this for consistent fades or movement, but do not assume cross-property pasting is supported.

title: Apply Chroma Key to remove a solid background in Luxea
note: Drag Chroma Key from Luxea's Filters panel onto a timeline clip. Open the effect options in Properties, choose the target color, and adjust Tolerance and Softness to remove the background and soften edges. The effect is specific to the Luxea 8 interface.

title: Load custom LUTs in Luxea Pro 8
note: For Luxea Pro 8, select a timeline clip and open Advanced Effects > Color LUT. Choose an existing LUT or import a supported .cube or .3dl file from the Properties panel. Test the look with the source footage; LUTs are not substitutes for correcting exposure and color balance.

title: Replace selected colors in Luxea Pro 8
note: To replace a color in Luxea 8, select a clip, open Advanced Effects > Replace Color, and configure the target color, replacement color, and similarity threshold. Test edge detail and shadows before applying aggressively.
